action.why: Ch 3 floor about Lv 41: Advanced side trips (Sirocco's Bishop) on spare Licenses.

blessings.why: Avo and Mov for the final rush once Gilchris lights the map (Game8).
Halved damage on the turn the fire tiles go up.

deploy.note: 13 slots: Physic from Sofia, Theodora and Ninae behind the Fortress chokes; Simon holds a flank, Noctula dodges in the alleys. Nydine (cavalry in 2-wide alleys) and Nuzzuo sit.

missables.text: Talk to Aswan and Tahonia when they reach Theodora, then keep both alive to the end.

people.text: Talk with Theodora when he arrives: a guest now, joins in Part III Section 5 if alive.
Same as Aswan: talk, then park her behind the chokes.
Needs Creek's kill: not on Theodora's route. Kill him like any boss guard.

tips.text: Hold the alley chokes: Theodora and Ultand in front, Ninae adjacent, Sirocco and Lilian firing over them
Elephants charge 2-wide lanes: step out of the lane, then close it again
Don't cross the north edge of the main road until the chokes are clear: that lights the fire tiles
When the fire starts, fliers plus Kalla's Blessing finish Gilchris the same turn
